research.method: FFT snapshot from binaural rig compared against Oysterbnb frequency bins; matched to CMEMS salinity stability.
research.meaning: Confirms seawall concrete amplifies low frequency bands that visitors feel through handrails.

research.method: Hydrophone log segmented to 10 second windows; paired with underwater lux readings and Oysterbnb comfort rubric template.
research.meaning: Shows micro habitat thrives when midday light hits canopy; supports limiting fin kicks to preserve clarity.

composition.invitation: Hover 1.5 m above the canopy, match breath to shrimp pulses, note how sun pillars bend with each exhale.
composition.gesture: Gift seaweed crackers once snorkel buddy logs three pulses in a row.

research.method: Used Oysterbnb comfort scale with five minute bins; annotated smell notes to tie audio to culinary prompts.
research.meaning: Demonstrates how food vendors modulate atmosphere without overwhelming acoustic space.
